jobDescription.name: What makes Outdooractive unique worldwide
jobDescription.value:
For more than 30 years, we have been developing highly precise digital maps and data-driven innovations in an agile tech environment. With us, you will work on a unique product that combines tradition, nature, and modern innovation. As an owner-managed tech company based in the Allgäu region, we offer a working environment built on sustainability, strong values, and a clear vision for the future: to become the world’s largest digital travel guide.


Work on a one-of-a-kind digital platform ecosystem unlike anything else in the world. Become part of an international team of developers, cartographers, and many other experts who are passionately driving our product forward and already reaching more than 60 million people worldwide.


In an environment that brings together tradition and innovation, you will work with a team that is both down-to-earth and forward-thinking – driven by genuine conviction in what we do.

jobDescription.name: "Only by taking new paths you leave visible marks." Hartmut Wimmer, Founder Outdooractive
jobDescription.value:
You work in a structured, reliable, and precise manner with a strong commitment to quality? Even in complex accounting processes, you maintain an overview, think in a solution-oriented way, and want to make an important contribution to a professional finance organization through your work? Then join our Administration team as an Accountant.


Your mission:
As a Financial Accountant in the Administration department within Finance, you ensure the proper and efficient handling of all accounting processes. In this role, you take responsibility for day-to-day financial accounting operations, support the preparation of financial statements and tax filings, and work closely with internal interfaces as well as our subsidiaries. You will report directly to the CFO.

jobDescription.name: Your new job
jobDescription.value:
• Erstellung der Finanzbuchhaltung sowie der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung mittels DATEV
  • Mitwirkung bei der Anlagenbuchhaltung sowie bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen
  • Verantwortung für Rechnungsprüfung und Zahlungsverkehr
  • Überprüfung der Abrechnungen unserer Tochtergesellschaften
  • Erstellung von Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen, OSS-Meldungen, ZM usw.
  • Kassenbuchführung
  • Bearbeitung des Melde- und Bescheinigungswesens
  • Prüfung und Abwicklung von Reisekostenabrechnungen
  • Rechnungsprüfung
  • Sicherstellung einer sorgfältigen, strukturierten und termingerechten Abwicklung aller buchhalterischen Prozesse
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Bereichen innerhalb der Administration und des Finance-Umfelds
  • Die Ausübung der Rolle ist in Voll- oder Teilzeit möglich

jobDescription.name: How you can convince us of your qualities
jobDescription.value:
• Completed vocational training as a tax clerk, tax specialist, certified accountant, or a comparable qualification 
  • Several years of relevant professional experience in accounting 
  • Sound knowledge of accounting, VAT, and ideally income tax law 
  • Ability to independently and confidently handle international matters, particularly VAT-related aspects 
  • Proficient in using DATEV Accounting, DATEV Fixed Asset Accounting, and MS Office, especially Excel 
  • Independent, structured, and meticulous way of working 
  • High level of quality awareness, sense of responsibility, discretion, and reliability 
  • Team spirit, strong communication skills, and commitment

jobDescription.name: What we offer you
jobDescription.value:
Free Pro+ version of the Outdooractive app for our employees
Enjoy the best outdoor content and exclusive maps for all types of sports to plan your tours perfectly – for maximum safety and preparation on your outdoor adventures.


First aid courses
Be well prepared and stay safe during all your outdoor activities.


Flexible working hours
Work in a way that best fits your life.


Company pension scheme
We help you plan for the future with an attractive company pension scheme.


Support in difficult times
In challenging situations, we stand by your side with support and guidance.


Sustainability
We are GWÖ-certified and take responsibility for our planet – for example through regional suppliers, avoiding plastic, and making an annual donation to 1% for the Planet.


Food & energy
Fresh fruit, drinks, healthy snacks, and regular walk-and-talks bring energy, movement, and fresh ideas into the working day.


Eco-friendly mobility & fitness
Whether road bike, mountain bike, gravel bike, or e-bike – with your company bike, you can stay environmentally friendly and fit both on your commute and in your free time. You can also benefit from our corporate fitness offers to support your health.


Corporate benefits & DRV Travel Industry Card
Enjoy attractive discounts on products and services as well as travel benefits for exceptional experiences and perfectly equipped outdoor adventures.


Team events & traditions
Create unforgettable memories at our team events and celebrations – from the New Year reception and multi-day corporate events to the traditional Christmas tree praise ceremony.


Gifts
We celebrate you and your achievements with special surprises and gifts.


Family, values & future
Become part of a family-run company that lives innovation, sustainability, and a clear vision for the future.

jobDescription.value: As an Android Developer (f/m/d) you are part of the development team in our headquarters in Immenstadt in the Allgäu or in our branch in Cambridge (UK), which develops the technical basis and features of the Outdooractive platform. In addition to many new functions that are made available to our users here in cooperation with the other departments, the team also takes care of the server infrastructure, interfaces, data and the support of our Outdooractive API partners. Everyone in the team plays a significant role in the performance, scalability and stability of our platform.

jobDescription.name: Your new job
jobDescription.value:
• The expansion, improvement and maintenance of the Outdooractive apps.
  • Testing the robustness, edge cases, usability and reliability of the code.
  • The development of new features.
  • Looking for new, applicable technologies within the Apple eco system.
  • Working closely with the Creative, Platform and Community Division.

jobDescription.name: How you can convince us of your qualities
jobDescription.value:
• A university degree in computer science or a comparable vocational training.
  • Years of experience as Android Developer (f/m/d) and ideally the publishing of apps.
  • Profound understanding of the Android framework.
  • Experience with Android Studio.
  • High interest in wearables, the technology of Android systems and in the development of a platform for outdoor activtities.
  • Passion for outdoor sports, innovative technologies and social media.
  • Autonomous and solution-oriented work as part of the team characterize your way of working.

jobDescription.value: Are you passionate about innovative technologies and outdoor sports? Are you searching for a first-class vocational training in the field of informatics beginning autumn 2025? If so, an apprenticeship as an IT Specialist (f/m/d) with a main focus in application development at our headquarters in Immenstadt (Allgaeu) might be your perfect career start.

jobDescription.name: Your new job
jobDescription.value:
An experienced IT Specialist at Outdooractive guides you during your apprenticeship and shows you
  • how to realize and design software projects (e.g. homepages or applications for mobile devices) according to customer demands,
  • how to analyze complex IT systems as wells as plan and process diverse projects autonomously,
  • what a Customer-Relationship-Management and a Content-Management-System is,
  • how to analyze and solve occurring errors and faults with the help of experts and diagnosis systems.

jobDescription.name: How you can convince us of your qualities
jobDescription.value:
• You have a secondary school diploma (Mittlere Reife) or a vocational baccalaureate diploma (Fachabitur) with good grades in math, German and English.
  • You have a good technical/mathematical understanding and an ability to reason.
  • You are an enthusiastic worker, ready to assume responsibility and you enjoy working in a team.
  • You are reliable, autonomous and a motivated learner.
